h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nashik

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nashik

c: Nashik is close to our Vasai factory, about 120 km by road, so machines reach the city after a short drive. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nashik for the Nashik Municipal Corporation's gardens and for housing societies along Gangapur Road and College Road. We also supply schools, colleges and the industrial campuses in Satpur and Ambad.

Nashik's climate is kinder than most of Maharashtra. Summers are warm rather than harsh, the monsoon brings good rain from June to September, and winter mornings are cool and clear. People here walk and cycle a lot, and the Godavari ghats and city gardens see crowds at dawn. That makes an open gym near a walking track a sensible first project for a society or a ward park.

richText.heading: Sets for societies and industrial campuses

c: Housing societies usually want machines that couples and friends can use together. The
Fun Walker Double
lets two people walk side by side. The
Leg Press Cum Parallel Bar
gives younger members leg work and dips on one frame. For senior members, the
Tai Chi
wheel loosens the shoulders and arms at an easy pace.

Industrial campuses in Satpur and Ambad can use the same three near a canteen or the main gate, where shift workers pass twice a day. Since Nashik's rain is heavy for a few months, set each machine on a raised concrete footing with a slight slope. For children's equipment, see our
playground equipment in Nashik

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 120 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Does FunPlay install outdoor gyms in Nashik with its own team?
items.a: Either our own installation team or a dealer in the region handles it, depending on the schedule. Nashik is close to our Vasai factory, which makes site visits easy to plan.

items.q: Can a company in Satpur or Ambad MIDC order a staff gym?
items.a: Yes. Share the area you have, the number of workers per shift and some photos. We will suggest a set of machines and send a layout drawing with a quote.

items.q: Which season is best for installation in Nashik?
items.a: Any dry period. Grouted footings need a few dry days to set, so most clients plan installation before June or after the monsoon ends in September.
